page.content:
Mutant conqueror who breaks the Seldon Plan.

How The Mule connects

  • Work: Foundation and Empire — The Mule is the conqueror of Foundation and Empire.
  • Concept: Seldon Plan — The Mule is the mutant the Seldon Plan did not include.
  • Faction: First Foundation — The Mule conquers First Foundation worlds.

What is The Mule?

The Mule is the emotional-control mutant who conquers Foundation worlds psychohistory could not predict, forcing the Second Foundation into the open.

Key threads lead to Foundation and Empire, Seldon Plan and First Foundation.
